title.narrative: Improving access to lifesaving and sustainable WASH assistance to drought-affected populations in Kahda district, Banadir region, Somalia.

description.narrative:
ltp class="" style=""gtltspan style="font-size: 14px font-family:"gtThis proposed project is linked SHF allocation strategy and the cluster objectives by providing lifesaving WASH assistance, improving sustainable water, and reducing the risk of AWD/cholera outbreak through improved access to sanitation services, hygiene promotion, and hygiene supplies. The project targets drought-displaced IDPs in Kahda targeting 13000 people giving priority to minority groups and persons with disabilities. In Kahda the project willlt/spangtltspan lang="EN-US" style="font-size: 14px font-family:"gt target the population 7 IDP camps in Kahda, Banaaney IDP, Bakad IDP, Kismaayu IDP, Awbaalle IDP, Bishaaro IDP, Garasley IDP, and Janagale IDP camps with severe water and sanitation access limitations.lt/spangtlt/pgtltp style="mso-margin-top-alt:automso-margin-bottom-alt:auto line-height:normal" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-family:"gtlt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="mso-margin-top-alt:automso-margin-bottom-alt:auto line-height:normal" class="MsoNormal"gtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-US"gtAYUUB will improve access to emergency WASH services for IDPs by rehabilitating potential communal pipeline and water kiosks, hygiene distribution, hygiene promotion and latrines construction for IDPs in Kahda. AYUUB plans to provide emergency water supply through pipeline extension, water kiosks. The project will improve access to latrines by constructing 150 latrines, distribute hygiene supplies and sanitation tools. In total 13000 people will benefit from the project. IDPs sites and hosting minority groups is prioritized. The project has ensured inclusion of persons with disability while making latrines and distribution sites safe for women and girls. AYUUB will coordinate with nutrition and health partners in targeting same population in Kahda districts.lt/spangtltspan style="font-family:"gtlt/spangtlt/pgt
